$comment: Catalogue entries this pipeline provides, to be ingested into the Agora catalogue. Run details (retrieval date, checksum) are in the output's provinces.meta.json.

key.name: ine_code
key.description: INE province code: two digits, 01–52 (51 Ceuta and 52 Melilla are autonomous cities with province codes).

relation_types.description: The province belongs to the autonomous community (Ceuta and Melilla: the autonomous city itself).

description.es: Límites de las 52 provincias (incluidas Ceuta y Melilla), con su código INE y su nombre oficial.
description.en: Boundaries of the 52 provinces (Ceuta and Melilla included), with their INE code and official name.

processing.es: Del servicio WFS INSPIRE de unidades administrativas del IGN, en WGS84 (EPSG:4326).
processing.en: From IGN's INSPIRE administrative units WFS, in WGS84 (EPSG:4326).

datasets.title: Provincias de España (IGN, unidades administrativas INSPIRE)

description.es: El servicio publica el estado actual de los límites administrativos del IGN, sin fechas de vigencia: los datos son válidos a la fecha de su descarga.
description.en: The service publishes the current state of IGN's administrative boundaries, without validity dates; the data is valid as of its retrieval date.

excluded.name: Territorios no asociados a ninguna provincia
excluded.reason: The plazas de soberanía are not one of INE's provinces.

geometry.resolution: full (as published by IGN, not simplified)

description.es: Id de la provincia en el catálogo (es:ine:prov:{ine_code}).
Nombre oficial tal como lo publica el IGN; bilingüe donde lo es (por ejemplo, 'Alacant/Alicante').
description.en: Official name as published by IGN; bilingual where official (e.g. 'Alacant/Alicante').

description.es: Código INE de la comunidad autónoma.
description.en: INE code of the autonomous community.

description.es: Id de la comunidad autónoma en el catálogo (es:ine:ccaa:{ccaa_code}).
description.en: Catalogue id of the autonomous community (es:ine:ccaa:{ccaa_code}).

description.es: Código nacional del IGN (34 + comunidad + provincia + 00000).
